props.name: capability
props.remarks: Network Monitoring and Response capability enables continuous observation and analysis of network security events and anomalous behavior.

props.name: technology-platform

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Continuous network monitoring with coordinated detection and response capabilities.

props.name: data-entity

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Continuous monitoring and reassessment of trust are required for Zero Trust Architecture.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Network telemetry and automated response support continuous evaluation and adaptive enforcement.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Monitoring and response capabilities support detection, containment, and recovery under cyber resiliency objectives.

metadata.remarks: Network Monitoring and Response defines how network activity is observed, analyzed, and acted upon to detect misuse, compromise, or degradation. This pattern provides visibility and response triggers that inform access control, policy enforcement, egress discipline, and resiliency mechanisms. It does not define access policy, segmentation rules, or recovery orchestration.

props.name: defense-technique
